content_html:
watched #FIGHTER : Don’t miss this movie on Big Screen with 3 D Glasses on!!!

To be frank when the Trailer dropped I was not so excited to watch this movie as I felt its just another Bollywood movie of cooking a story around Surgical Strikes to encash the sentiment…….but Man I was wrong!!!! This is one of THE BEST INDIAN ACTION WAR FARE movie I watched on screen and it’s a must watch on 3D

To start with…..HRITHIK had just nailed it with his Greek God Looks and amazing screen presence and who better than Siddharth Anand knows how to project him on screen, he previously did the same with Bang Bang and WAR and now again in Fighter!!! Siddharth knows how best he can make use of Hrithik’s charismatic personality 😍 It was an eye feast to watch him in Airforce Uniform 🫡

DEEPIKA was 🔥 in this movie and in few scenes she literally snatches away our eyes from Hrithik…..she did a fantastic job!!!! and it was total 😍 to watch the pair of Hrithik & Deepika on screen and I wonder why it took so long to cast them together 🙏

Content wise it is a Tailor made Commercial Patriotic movie with Surgical Strike as backdrop filled with good emotional points and bit over the top patriotism and obviously villian being Pakistan 😉

apart from Hrithik and Deepika’s excellent screen presence…..The Action parts are the Heart and Soul of this movie and I have never seen such AIR stunts in an Indian Movie which literally gives Goosebumps and provide WOW factor to this movie!!! Especially watch them

in 3D for a wonderful experience 🔥😍🫡

a MUST WATCH movie for all the Action movie lovers and especially Kids…..and if you are Hrithik (or) Deepika fan then its a Double Dhamaka for you guyz!!!!!
